name: pigzombie-anger
comment: WP-2.3b. Stone platform y = 60 over -10..10, a fence row (id 85) at x = 0; day (EntityZombie's daylight burn roll runs for the fire-immune pigmen). Player (id 0) at (2.5, 61, 0.5) facing -x, given a fishing rod (346) through use_item on a workbench at (5, 61, 4); three zombie pigmen (ids 1-3) beyond the fence; the harness kind FishingHook (id 4) flies over the fence and hooks pigman 1: EntityFish's attackEntityFrom(angler, 0) is a player's hit, so EntityPigZombie.attackEntityFrom angers every pigman within 32 (becomeAngryAt: playerToAttack, angerLevel 400 + rand.nextInt(400), randomSoundDelay rand.nextInt(40)), then EntityMob's (0 damage, knock-back, the target). The pigmen run (moveSpeed 0.95) to the fence and cannot reach the player; the angry sound when randomSoundDelay runs out. rng_state and entity_state (all, the player included: it is never hit) every tick.
